about: Console-only messages and fields added to omega-embed/1 (CP P7, P8, P15, P19; learning service P1-03; RL 1275A; PL-38). Studio does not participate in the document probe/proof extension; this is not the shared canonical omega-embed-1.json. A key must echo this Console document's doc or it is ignored and the Console keeps asking, then reports needs-key. Safe hello-before-load authentication and post-load recovery require the coordinated host probe/child proof exchange: a host suspends readiness on load and accepts only a fresh live-document proof, never queued hello/gate as load attribution. The host must validate these closed document message shapes and mirror this additions fixture; omega-embed-1.additions.test.ts holds the Console to it.

doc.rule: The frame's document nonce: base64url without padding of 16 bytes from crypto.getRandomValues (128 bits), drawn once per document load of the frame; an in-place reload is a new document with a new doc. Every embed.hello, embed.gate and embed.proof a document sends carries its doc, to an exact origin only (never "*"). It is not a secret from the host, but it is never put in a URL, a log line, storage or telemetry, and no other child message carries it but embed.models.request, which carries it so that the host's embed.models answer can echo it.

want.rule: Ask for this many keys in one mint (CP P7). Absent means one. A host that ignores it answers with one key, as before.

embed.key.rule: Only type, token, doc and optional left are allowed. A message with any unknown field is ignored as a whole: no key is handed on, no origin is locked and hello continues.

left.rule: How many more embed.key messages this answer to one hello carries. Absent or 0: the answer is complete, so the child may say hello again. Send the keys of one answer back to back.

doc.rule: Echo the doc of the accepted embed.hello or fresh embed.proof this key answers, on every key of that answer. The console uses a key only when its doc is the console's own document's: a key with another doc (an answer minted for the document before an in-place reload, a replay) or with no doc is ignored; it opens nothing and the console keeps asking. Mint for the hello/proof you read the doc from: never re-use a doc from an earlier document.

embed.gate.rule: The console's gate, named by the document that sends it: ready only after this document received a key bearing its own doc and its first authenticated API read (GET /workspace/capabilities, using that opening key once) succeeded with a compatible, available capabilities answer. Receipt of a key alone never means ready. A 401 or 403 on that read means refused; other failures or a read that never completes keep waiting, then mean needs-key at the existing 6-second session bound. A response after that bound cannot mean ready. A later API refusal can still mean refused. A host counts a gate only for its active document, established by an accepted hello or fresh one-use proof; a gate with another doc changes nothing. While a load suspends that candidate, ordinary queued hello/gate cannot restore readiness; only the living document's fresh probe response can revalidate it.

doc.rule: As on embed.hello: the doc of the document that sends the gate.

embed.probe.rule: A fresh one-use host challenge for an ambiguous iframe load, not a document identity or a key. The host draws 16 cryptographic random bytes on each load that suspends a candidate, invalidates the previous challenge, and accepts a matching proof only from the frame's own window at its exact expected origin. The child accepts only these two fields, from window.parent at an exact allowed origin (and its keyed origin once locked), and answers only to that requesting origin. A probe never stops hello, locks an origin, authenticates a session or emits a gate.

embed.proof.rule: A live response built only by the bridge for a validated embed.probe. Echo its challenge with this document's doc, the same protocol/build/opening want as hello, and only the last actual gate this bridge reported. Before any gate, omit state entirely; a key alone never supplies ready. This is not a new authentication verdict and does not extend the 6000 ms boot bound. The host consumes only its current outstanding challenge once, rejects retired document nonces, and remints for the proved document before restoring admission. A supplied ready cannot override mint failure or a newer gate received during that mint. No unknown fields are allowed. Send only to the exact requesting parent origin, never to all configured origins or '*'; never put doc or challenge in a URL, storage, logs or telemetry.

want.rule: The opening hello's batch request; absent means one key.

state.rule: The last actual gate reported by this document's bridge; absent before any gate. Never infer ready from a probe or key receipt.

routeTemplate.rule: A page template the console declares (/agents/:agentId) or *, never a concrete path

embed.telemetry.hostRule: Forward errors to the host's error tracker tagged product=omega-console and vitals to its performance view. Never add free text: every field is already closed.

embed.score.rule: Learning service P1-03. The viewer scores one run in the embedded Console; the host writes the Score on that run's trace AS THE VIEWER (the viewer's own session, never a workspace key) and answers with embed.scored carrying the same id. The child sends it only to the origin that delivered its key. agentId and runId are the EE agent and task ids the run's spans carry (omega.agent.id, omega.task.id). At least one of thumb, rating or comment; nothing else is sent. A host that ignores it sends no answer, and the Console then shows the score as not saved.

comment.rule: What the viewer typed, trimmed; no control characters other than tab and line breaks; a blank comment is left out.

embed.scored.rule: The host's answer to one embed.score, to the frame that sent it: saved when it wrote the Score as the viewer, refused otherwise (no session, no such run in the viewer's projects, a write the viewer may not make). Send exactly one answer per score.

id.rule: The id of the embed.score it answers.

embed.palette.open.rule: Mod+K (Cmd+K or Ctrl+K) or the Console's Search, used inside the frame, asks the host to open its command palette, and the Console opens none of its own. Sent only to the origin that delivered the key and only while the Console's gate is ready, each time right after an embed.palette.commands with the current list. A host with a palette opens it, which moves focus out of the frame. When focus is still in the frame ackMs later, the Console takes it that the host shows no palette: it opens its own, and for the rest of that document opens it at once without asking, unless focus leaves the frame within lateMs of that or the host runs one of its commands.

embed.palette.commands.rule: The Console's commands for the host's palette, most useful first; each list replaces the last. A host that finds any entry out of bounds ignores the whole list, so the Console checks and trims every entry before it sends. An id stays the same for the same command, so a host may keep recent ones; a host answers a pick only with embed.palette.run. Sent only to the origin that delivered the key and only while the gate is ready: when the gate says ready and again resendMs later (a list that reaches a host before it listens is lost, and a host never asks for one), whenever the list changes, with each embed.palette.open, and resendMs after each embed.probe.

title.rule: Not blank, and no control characters.

group.rule: Not blank, and no control characters.

items.rule: Not blank, and no control characters.

embed.palette.run.rule: A person picked one of the Console's commands in the host's palette. Post it to the Console frame's window at the Console's origin. The Console runs it only when it comes from window.parent at the origin that delivered its key, while its gate is ready, with no other field, and only for an id in the last list it sent; anything else is ignored.

id.rule: The id of a command in the Console's last embed.palette.commands.

embed.nav-side.rule: The workspace's agents, each with its latest chats, for the host's own sidebar where the host draws the Console's navigation. Display state only, never authorization: every path is a Console route, which does its own checks. A message of its own: embed.host, embed.chrome and embed.nav are unchanged, and a host that does not know this type ignores it. Sent only after the host answered embed.host with navigation "host", only to the origin that delivered the key, and again on every change (a new chat, a rename, a run's state, the route in view), at most once every spacingMs; each message replaces the last wholesale. Nothing is sent until the Console's reads of the workforce list and of the conversations have both answered, and a failed read is never sent as an empty list: the host keeps the last message it had, or draws no group. Every object carries exactly its listed fields; a host drops the whole message when a field is unknown or a value is out of bounds, and keeps the last good one. Titles are plain text, never HTML. The host draws the entries in the order sent and does not re-sort or filter them.

workspaceAgent.rule: The Workspace Agent's entry: always the first, the only one with pinned, its path paths.newChat, and sent even when it has no chats (chats: []).

embed.nav-side.pathRule: Console routes; the host prefixes its own base path, as for embed.nav items. {id} is the entry's own id. An agent's row: agentChat (a new chat with that agent) for an agent the workforce list names, where the workspace binds a chat to a named agent; newChat (a new chat with the Workspace Agent) for the Workspace Agent and for every other agent. A chat's row: chat. moreChats: allChats, the Chat page, whose sidebar holds every chat of every agent. moreAgents: allAgents, the Workspace agents list.

agents.rule: The agents the Console's own sidebar lists, in its order: the Workspace Agent first, then every agent with a chat waiting on the person, then every agent with a chat working, then the rest by their latest chat (where the workspace has more than eight other agents, only the eight with the latest chats in the last 30 days); past maxItems the rest are behind moreAgents.

id.rule: The agent's stable id, opaque; workspaceAgent.id for the Workspace Agent.

title.rule: The agent's name as the Console's sidebar draws it, plain text: no control characters and no space at either end, a longer name shortened at a word with "…".

path.rule: paths.agentChat with this id, or paths.newChat (pathRule).

badge.rule: How many of that agent's chats wait on the person; absent when none.

chats.rule: The agent's latest chats, latest first; [] when it has none.

id.rule: Unique across the whole message: a chat is under one agent only.

title.rule: The chat's title as the Console's sidebar draws it, plain text, shortened as an agent's title is.

state.rule: The mark the Console's sidebar draws for a chat that is not finished; absent for a finished or stopped chat. It carries no words: draw it as a small mark, or not at all.

moreChats.rule: Present when the agent has more chats than chats.maxItems.

title.rule: The Console's own words, sent ready to draw: "Show all {n} chats" with {n} the count.

moreAgents.rule: Present when the Console lists more agents than are sent.

count.rule: As the Console's own sidebar counts them: the agents the workforce list names, or every agent the sidebar draws where the list names none.

title.rule: The Console's own words, sent ready to draw: "Show all {n} agents" with {n} the count.

active.rule: The entry whose path is the Console route in view, for the host's highlight: a chat sent in this message, else the first agent sent with that path; null when neither is in view.

embed.models.rule: The models this person may start a chat on, for the Console's model picker: the rows of Future AGI's console-models list (read with the person's own session at that moment, never from a cache), unchanged and in that list's order, with the host's signed attestation of exactly those rows when it has one. Post it to the Console frame's window at the Console's origin only in answer to an embed.models.request, exactly once for each request accepted, echoing that request's doc and requestId; never unprompted, never on a timer, and never a list whose attestation has expired. Where the list cannot be read, send nothing: the Console's bounded wait applies. The Console hears it only from window.parent at the origin that delivered its key, so a list sent before a key is ignored, and holds it only for the person, organization and workspace its newest key names: a key that names others forgets it until a list comes again. The Console takes only an answer to an ask it still awaits, and holds its list unless the answer to a newer ask is held already; an answer to an ask with model also goes, as it came, to the new chat that asked, and its runAuthorization reaches that chat alone and is never held with the list. A message with any field outside these (a version or a model echo among them), a doc that is not the asking document's, a requestId outside its shape or naming no ask the Console awaits, a wrong type, a value out of bounds, a repeated model or top_rank, a payers list without its billing_mode, a managed row that is not priced, a model id outside its one shape or containing notContaining, a router id, or a priced row whose input or output price is not above zero is ignored as a whole (the last three are the tests Omega's own check of the rows makes, so the two judge every list alike), and the Console keeps the last list it accepted. Never send the list's sources: their error text is not for people. The list is what the picker offers, never a permission: the Console sends the rows and the attestation untouched with a new chat, and Omega admits a model only from rows whose attestation it has checked. Send it only where Omega admits from it. Where no list comes, or the list is empty, the Console reads the workspace's models from Omega as before.

doc.rule: Echo the doc of the embed.models.request this answers. The Console takes an answer only when its doc is its own document's: an answer with another doc (one asked for by the document before an in-place reload, a replay) is ignored.

requestId.rule: Echo the requestId of the embed.models.request this answers, on every answer: a list-only answer, an answer to an ask with model, and a refusal to mint. It is the one correlation: an answer carries no model field. The Console takes an answer only for an ask it still awaits; an answer to an ask it no longer awaits (already answered, past its wait, or forgotten when a key named others, the gate left ready or the session ended) is ignored.

models.rule: Every row of the console-models list: at most 200, the list's own bound, top rows always kept.

model.rule: The exact model string the run path sends for this row; the Console sends it back as the new chat's modelId. Every row's model meets this one pattern whatever its source, never contains notContaining, and is never a router id: none of notIds, and no id whose last / segment is notLastSegment, each compared in any case.

name.rule: Not blank, no space at either end, and no control characters.

vendor.rule: As name, or null where the model's maker is not known.

billing_mode.rule: The payer the run path picks for this model today, in the gateway's own words.

payers.rule: Every payer that could serve the model, each once; always includes billing_mode.

priced.rule: A managed row is always priced.

input_per_mtok_usd.rule: USD per 1M tokens: a number above zero on a priced row, null on a row with no price. A priced row with 0 here makes the whole list malformed.

cached_input_per_mtok_usd.rule: A number or null on a priced row; null on a row with no price.

top_rank.rule: 1 to 12 on a top row, 1 first, each once; null on every other row.

attestation.rule: The host's signed statement of exactly these rows for this person: a compact signed token (three base64url parts joined by dots) with a short life. The Console never decodes or checks it, and carries it untouched with a new chat together with the rows; Omega checks it. A host with none leaves it out, and the Console then sends the picked model alone.

runAuthorization.rule: Future AGI's run authorization for a new chat on the asked model: present only on the answer to an embed.models.request that named a model, and only when the mint succeeded; never on an answer to an ask without model. Text of 1 to 4096 characters with no whitespace and no control character; any other value is treated as absent and the answer's list is still accepted. An answer to an ask with model without it is a refusal to mint: that chat starts without one, never with one from an earlier answer. The Console never decodes or checks it (Omega and Future AGI's signer do), never holds it with the list, and keeps it in memory only for the one new chat that asked; it never writes it to storage, logs, telemetry, the address bar or an error report, and sends it untouched, as runAuthorization, only with that new chat, never with a follow-up or a workspace choice.

embed.models.request.rule: The Console asks for a fresh model list once as its gate turns ready (the frame handshake is complete), when the person opens or reopens the model choice, and when a key names another person, organization or workspace; and it asks for one model right before a new chat on the host's rows starts on it. Sent only to the origin that delivered the key, and only while the gate is ready. For the same person, organization and workspace, an ask without model is sent at most once every minIntervalMs (an open within that time of the last such ask sends nothing); a key naming another identity resets that interval so its first list is asked for immediately. An ask with model is sent for every such start and is not counted against that interval. Accept it only from the Console frame's window at the Console's origin, after the frame handshake, with the doc of the frame's current document; never refuse or delay an ask for its timing: minIntervalMs paces the Console's own asks, not the host's answers. Send no answer to an ask whose requestId is missing or outside its shape, or whose model breaks the model rules. Answer each ask accepted with exactly one embed.models echoing its doc and requestId, holding a fresh list read from the server at that moment, never from a cache, with its attestation; for an ask with model, add runAuthorization only when that model is one of the list's rows and the mint succeeds, and otherwise answer without it (a refusal to mint). Keep nothing after answering.

doc.rule: As on embed.hello: the doc of the document that asks. The host echoes it on its answer.

requestId.rule: Fresh for every ask, an open's included (a random UUID from the browser's secure randomness), and never reused while the document lives. The host echoes it on its answer and keeps nothing; the Console takes an answer only for an ask it still awaits.

model.rule: The model a new chat on the host's rows is about to start on, by the same rules as a row's model (router ids and the last segment compared in any case). Present only on the ask right before such a start; an open of the model choice, a workspace pick and a follow-up send none. The Console waits for the answer to this ask alone for at most 3000 ms; without one, the chat starts with the list it was picked from and no run authorization, and an answer that comes later is ignored.

frame.allow: clipboard-write lets the frame's Copy reference button write the clipboard; without it the reference stays selectable

hostRule: A hello with want is answered with at most want keys minted in one exchange call; each key stays one-use and short-lived. The child drops a pooled key 5 s before it expires.
